name: Paddle MCP Server
summary: Paddle's official MCP server for Paddle Billing: manage products, prices, customers, subscriptions, transactions, refunds and reports.
description: Near parity with the Paddle API, and each tool is marked read-only or non-destructive. Run with `npx -y @paddle/paddle-mcp` and set PADDLE_API_KEY and PADDLE_ENVIRONMENT (sandbox or production). Limit the loaded tools with `--tools` or PADDLE_MCP_TOOLS, e.g. non-destructive. Works with Paddle Billing only, not Paddle Classic. Paddle is a merchant of record. Apache-2.0 (npm `@paddle/paddle-mcp` 0.1.6).
